text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning and Python developer with 6 years of experience. I’d be glad to help with your financials dashboard migration and the nightly data pull automation. I can work through the current setup, suggest the best approach for the automation pieces you already have, and help build a reliable BI workflow that supports the dashboard transition from Power BI.

I’m comfortable working with Python, pandas, scikit-learn, and ML-oriented data pipelines, and I pay close attention to reliability, maintainability, and clean handoffs between data preparation and the reporting layer. For a project like this, I’d focus first on understanding the current data sources, the existing automation tools, and how the financial dashboard is being used now, so we can reduce risk during the migration and make sure the nightly pulls are dependable.

One relevant project I’ve done was a Support ticket triage model for Kettlewell Support Co. I built a classifier that routes incoming helpdesk tickets to 14 queues, served by FastAPI, with nightly retraining run through a Celery worker on Redis. That project improved macro-F1 to 0.88 versus 0.62 for the old keyword rules, and reduced median routing time from 6 hours to 4 minutes. While the domain was different, the work required careful automation, dependable scheduled processing, and a production-minded approach to data workflows.

For your project, I’d be happy to help assess the best path forward for nightly automation, identify any gaps in the current tooling, and support the dashboard development effort as it moves away from Power BI. I’m also comfortable collaborating closely as priorities evolve over a 1–3 month engagement or longer if needed.

If you’d like, I can start by reviewing the current automation approach and outlining a practical implementation plan for the nightly pulls and dashboard migration.
